lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in at least four horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a localized lattice pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent linear feature running horizontally along the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp luminance gradient with peak intensity on the dorsal edge and a shadow-filled trough below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch or indentation is visible on the trailing (posterior) margin of the left pectoral fin.
